IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Wallace, Springer, Kelley, and Morris

Bill.BriefDescription: Increasing the time limit for filing property tax refund claims.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing the time limit for filing propertytax refund claims; and amending RCW 84.69.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.69.030 and 2009 c 350 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((No)) Orders for a refund under this chapter ((shall be madeexcept)) are permitted only on a claim: (1) Verified by the person who paid the tax, the person's guardian,executor or administrator; ((and)) (2) Filed with the county treasurer within ((three)) five yearsafter the due date of the payment sought to be refunded; and (3) Stating the statutory ground upon which the refund is claimed.
